text:
sophia: FYI customer BrightEdge opened a support+onboard ask for 'Crow-8B' — they see a jump in low-confidence hallucinations after we applied 4-bit quant. dropping here for triage. sample prompts + logs attached in drive link.
maria: linking the drive now. any specific failing prompts or metric diffs? :thinking_face:
sophia: they noted FAQ answers that used to be short are now verbose/confab. per-customer eval: exact-match down ~7%, BLEU-style down ~4. their perf numbers attached.
aj: can you paste the quant cmd they ran? maybe we missed per-layer exceptions.
sophia: here's the minimal repro they used:
```bash
python quantize.py --model ./crow8b/fp16 --out ./crow8b/ggml-4bit --bits 4 --per_channel True --skip_layer_norm False
```
they said they used our default recipe from onboarding guide.
lee: quick checklist:
- reproduce on our infra with same recipe
- run FP16 -> Q4 eval on customer's prompt set
- compare logits/top-k distrib and attention scale
- sanity-check tokenizer/byte-pair merge mismatch
sam: assigning to quant runway. i'll spin a container and run smoke evals. ETA 2h.
maria: also request customer to confirm exact hf-transformers tokenizer version + any custom tokens. mismatched tokenization often causes weird output.
quant-bot: queued job #9371: quant-smoke-crow8b (queued -> running)
aj: if regressions replicate, plan: try per-channel vs per-tensor, and try skipping quant on first 2 and last 2 layers. also compare 8-bit LLM.int8() path to our 4-bit for quality baseline.
sophia: customer asks for timeline — small POC or dedicated instance? They prefer dedicated if perf holds.
lee: triage decision: PRIORITY = P2 (customer-impacting but not blocking). Next steps:
1) reproduce on dev (sam)
2) collect tokenization diff and topk/logit diffs (maria)
3) try alternative quant recipes + run evals (aj)
4) if quality still bad, propose hybrid: keep KV-cache in fp16 and quantize rest (proposal doc)
sam: started run on g4dn. logs: s3://redwood-ml/crow8b/qa/9371/
maria: found tokenizer mismatch: customer's tokenizer adds custom token "<BRIGHT>" at index 50288, ours at 50290 — this shifts ids for some prompts. reporting as likely root cause.
sophia: excellent catch. notify customer and ask for their tokenizer file to ensure exact match. cc @BrightEdge
aj: still will run alternate quant variants once tokenizer is aligned, to be safe.
quant-bot: job #9371 completed: smoke evals -> FP16 baseline vs Q4 diffs attached (artifact link)
sam: smoke results: once we used customer's tokenizer, exact-match drop reduced to ~1.2% (within noise). prior large regressions reproduced only when tokenizer mismatched.
lee: outcome: not a quant algorithm bug, tokenization mismatch compounded with 4-bit rounding amplified differences. recommend adding tokenizer checksum gating to onboarding checklist.
sophia: agreed. action items:
- add tokenizer checksum step in intake form (maria)
- update onboarding doc with suggested fallback: preserve embedding layer in FP16 when custom tokens detected (aj)
- follow up with BrightEdge about dedicated capacity once they confirm tests (sophia)
maria: i'll draft intake field and open PR against docs. ETA EOD.
aj: will prototype hybrid quant skip on embedding weights and test perf/latency tradeoffs.
sophia: thanks team. closing triage for now but will reopen if customer reports new anomalies. :thumbsup:
